'''Timothy Pavuk''' was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], listed as Red 52 from Sherwood, Ar. The slot was marked Retired after Decipher's SWCCG run.<ref name="sm-fan" /> [[Winfried Sommerfeld]] (Red 41) named him among the friends he made through Star Wars CCG.<ref name="decsq-sommerfeld">[http://decipher.com/volunteers/squadrons/players/sommerfeldwinfried.html Star Wars CCG Squadrons: Red 41], decipher.com (page last modified 28 June 1999). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001023104822/http://decipher.com:80/volunteers/squadrons/players/sommerfeldwinfried.html Internet Archive]</ref>
